headline: Gandhar Oil Refinery expands capacity by 240,000 kl as Indian plants hit 82% utilization

headline: Gandhar's group volumes hit by UAE disruption despite India growth

headline: Gandhar Oil Refinery expects stable product spreads through FY27 Q4
hook: Strong product spreads projected for two years
summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery has guided for product spreads of Rs 29,000 per kilolitre to sustain through the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027. Product spreads represent the difference between the cost of raw materials and the price of finished petroleum and white oil products. Maintaining healthy spreads helps protect operating margins against raw material volatility. Retail investors holding the stock can assess long-term operational profitability against these management projections.
why_it_matters: Sustained product spreads support operating margins for Gandhar.
winners_losers: Gandhar holders gain / margin-pressure peers unaffected
